findings.description: The requirement mandates detection at the exact expiry instant. CON-SUP-105 identifies expiry as the instant from which the 50 ms safe-state reaction is measured; it does not require late-start detection at that instant. CON-SUP-103 explicitly specifies expiry detection for an overrun, but does not state that deadline for a late start.
findings.requested_change: Establish a source-supported late-start detection deadline, or record the missing decision as a blocking open point.

findings.description: The requirement accepts a start exactly at expiry but requires detection at expiry if the task has not started. CON-SUP-103 specifies 100 µs measurement resolution, and OP-SYS-009 leaves unresolved how a start in the same measurement step as expiry is distinguished. Tests away from the boundary do not establish pass or fail at that boundary.
findings.requested_change: Classify OP-SYS-009 as blocking so the boundary behaviour can be decided before the requirement is verified.
